changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE "document".document ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS template_id UUID; CREATE TABLE document.notice ( id UUID NOT NULL, document_id UUID NOT NULL, buyer_id UUID, seller_id UUID, name_uz TEXT, name_ru TEXT, name_en TEXT, number INTEGER, status TEXT, template_json TEXT, created_by UUID, deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
